Hi Emma / Ryan,

Great to meet you both on the demo yesterday — really appreciated the product context and your launch goals for Q4. Per our conversation I attached a first-draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a short sprint playbook that outlines an 8-week onboarding with milestone owners, acceptance criteria, and a suggested cutover window.

Key highlights in the MAP:
- Week 0: Admin setup, API keys & test data
- Week 1–2: Integration validation (small batch), pre-tokenization checks
- Week 3: Performance bench & quantization recommendation (if desired)
- Week 4–6: Feature rollout + internal UAT cycles
- Week 7: Cutover readiness & dry run
- Week 8: Go-live and 30-day success metrics cadence

Action items for this thread:
1) Please confirm the proposed cutover week (tentative: 2026-08-03).
2) Share any SSO/KMS constraints or procurement timing that could impact Week 0.
3) Once confirmed, I’ll loop in Olga (Implementation Lead) and Marissa (CS) to scope the runbook and staffing.

Attachments: Iridian_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (MAP draft) — contains milestone owners and a short acceptance checklist.

Thanks — I’ll keep this short. Looking forward to your thoughts.

Best,
Ben Carter

3) Marissa / Neha / Olga — we’ll propose a two-hour workshop slot for integration kickoff the week of 2026-06-21 and circulate an agenda.

I’ll start a shared Drive folder and populate the runbook templates. HubSpot link and draft MAP are attached for your reference.
